original_report: 支付渠道轮询首个交易被路由到第二个渠道，第一个渠道在每轮轮询中永远被跳过一次，流量分布不均。
diagnosis: 轮询索引先自增后取值使序列整体前移：应先取当前值再推进索引。修复原则：取值与推进的顺序决定首轮行为。
patch_diff:
--- a/target.py
+++ b/target.py
@@ -6,5 +6,6 @@
         self.pos = 0
 
     def pick(self):
+        ch = self.channels[self.pos]
         self.pos = (self.pos + 1) % len(self.channels)
-        return self.channels[self.pos]
+        return ch
verification_tests:
from target import ChannelPicker

def test_first_is_zero():
    cp = ChannelPicker(["c1", "c2"])
    assert cp.pick() == "c1"

def test_cycle():
    cp = ChannelPicker(["c1", "c2"])
    got = [cp.pick() for _ in range(4)]
    assert got == ["c1", "c2", "c1", "c2"]

def test_three_cycle():
    cp = ChannelPicker(["x", "y", "z"])
    got = [cp.pick() for _ in range(3)]
    assert got == ["x", "y", "z"]
applicable_conditions: 轮询/游标先自增后取值
